title: 5 Steps to Your
<g>First AI Workflow</g>
subtitle: Not the biggest job. The one you can prove in a month.

cards.title: Watch a real week of work
cards.body: Every task gets written down. No tools, no AI yet.

cards.title: Cut the steps nobody needs
cards.body: Make it simpler on paper first. Never automate a mess.

cards.title: Choose one workflow
cards.body: It repeats, it has clear rules, and it is safe if it goes wrong.

cards.title: Build it on your own tools
cards.body: Shown working, tested together. Not described in a deck.

cards.title: Hand it over
cards.body: It runs in your business, in your words. You can extend it alone.
